name: History Taking — General

anchors.90-100: No errors; native-like medical register throughout
anchors.70-80: Occasional minor errors; fully intelligible; appropriate register
anchors.50-60: Some structural errors requiring listener effort
anchors.10-20: Very frequent errors; comprehension significantly impaired

anchors.90-100: All medical terminology and clinical facts correct
anchors.50-60: Some incorrect terminology or clinical reasoning

anchors.90-100: Clear differential verbalized; dangerous diagnosis prioritized; systematic approach
anchors.70-80: Reasonable differential implied; key risk factors explored
anchors.50-60: Some structured reasoning but key items missed

anchors.90-100: Smooth, natural pacing; appropriate signposting; no disruptive hesitation
anchors.10-20: Communication severely disrupted by fluency issues

anchors.90-100: Exceptional empathy and professionalism; creates psychological safety
anchors.70-80: Good empathy; acknowledges emotion; polite and professional
anchors.50-60: Adequate but mechanical empathy; some emotional cues missed
anchors.30-40: Little empathic response; information delivery prioritized
anchors.10-20: No empathic response; dismissive or unprofessional

checklist.item: used Teach-back method to verify patient understanding

empathy_markers: used patient's name at least once
appropriate pause/space given for patient emotion
